cd /workspace && OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/workspace/native PYTHONPATH=/workspace/.deps:/workspace/submission python3 - <<'EOF'
import sys, numpy as np
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
from te.algorithms.communication.partial_barrier import PartialBarrier
from te.algorithms.sub_algorithms.mlu_backends.pdlp_mlu import PDLPMLU
from te.algorithms.formulations.path_based.distributed.coordinator import Coordinator

b=PartialBarrier(3,2,1,4)
print("blocked:", b.blockers(), b.advance())
b.arrive(0,[1.,2.,0.,0.])
print("after w0:", b.blockers(), b.ages())
b.arrive(1,[0.,1.,0.,0.])
b.arrive(2,[0.,0.,1.,0.])
print("all seen:", b.blockers(), "can", b.can_advance())
print("advance:", b.advance(), "clock", b.clock, "fresh", b.fresh)
print("ages", b.ages())

for mode in ('route','admit'):
    s=PDLPMLU(4, 1.0, mode)
    s.update_F_m([10.,1.,-3.,0.5])
    z,h,t=s.solve()
    print(mode,"h",h,"z",z,"t",t,"sumt",t.sum())

c=Coordinator(4, 2.0, 0.75)
z,h,t,u=c.step(np.array([3.,1.,0.,2.]), None, 'route')
print("coord route:", h, z, t, u)
c.retune(4)
print("after retune dual", c.dual)
z,h,t,u=c.step(np.array([0.,0.,0.,0.]), None, 'admit')
print("coord admit:", h, z, t, u)
EOF
